The climate in Primorsko

Primorsko is about 19 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 27°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 2°C. Around 840 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 105 mm). The highest temperature in Primorsko in 2015–2024 was 41°C (26 July 2023) and the lowest −10°C (8 January 2017).

Primorsko is on the southern Black Sea coast, on a peninsula between two bays, and has some of the longest beaches on the Bulgarian coast. The southern coast is warmer and drier than the north, and the sea is usually warm enough for swimming from June to the end of September.

Best time to visit Primorsko

The most pleasant weather in Primorsko is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 24°C and 27°C, with up to 9 days of rain a month.
